expectations.text: Uses resource() with the stream property for streaming responses
expectations.evidence: ai-chat.component.ts uses imperative `await fetch()` with manual ReadableStream reading in an async send() method. No resource() usage at all.

expectations.text: Uses ResourceStreamItem signal pattern inside the stream function
expectations.evidence: No ResourceStreamItem imported or used. Streaming is done via manual signal.update() calls in a while loop.

expectations.text: Separates user input signal from submitted prompt signal (no fetch on keystroke)
expectations.evidence: ai-chat.component.ts:130 has `userInput = signal('')` and fetch only triggers on send() button click, not on input changes.

expectations.text: Uses linkedSignal to accumulate chat history across multiple responses
expectations.evidence: No linkedSignal imported or used. Chat history managed via `messages = signal<ChatMessage[]>([])` with manual `.update()` calls.

expectations.text: Template shows loading state while streaming
expectations.evidence: No explicit loading indicator in template. The isStreaming signal disables the send button but no visual loading state shown in the messages area.

expectations.text: Template displays error state with retry option
expectations.evidence: Errors are appended inline as '[Error: ...]' text to the last assistant message. No dedicated error UI or retry button.
